scheme_name: SERB Science and Technology Award for Research
other_conditions: Must have completed an individual‑centric SERB project in the previous three financial years with an “Excellent” grade
Only the Principal Investigator of such projects is eligible, not Co‑Principal Investigators

Applicant must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized academic institution, national laboratory, or other recognized R&D institution (regular meaning appointment to a sanctioned post or tenure post likely to be renewed)
Principal Investigators with an ongoing fellowship/honorarium such as the JC Bose Fellowship, Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize, Swarnajayanti Fellowship, etc., are not eligible
Unsuccessful nominees may be re‑nominated in the following year if they meet all other eligibility criteria
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹15,000, plus an annual research grant of ₹10 lakh and ₹1 lakh overhead for three years.
